evidence.note: maxResults early-return writes conforms:false with truncated:true; the completion write at line 208 sets truncated:false and conforms from violations.length===0, so truncated-and-conforming is never constructed.
Truncation fires only when violations.length >= maxResults, so truncated => has-violations => !conforms.
toVerdict admits only conforms && !truncated; truncated-true is folded into rejected with no combined-true arm.

notes: Validation completeness conforming|violating|truncated flattened into two bits. Schema lives in semantic-web; this is the in-lane exclusive writer.

disqualifier.note: Independent per-module dirtiness probes over changed signatures: subClass/subProperty vs any-predicate domain/range vs disjointWith/type. A predicate change can fire all three; inferOntologySession already triaged drifted/fullRecompute.

Independent IRI classifiers (vocab namespace vs ontology type IRIs vs property type IRIs vs TBox predicates). Overlap is legal (owl:Class is both a vocab IRI and an ontology type IRI); resourceKindFor matches types, not a masked union of these bits.

Independent coherence observations collected as separate filter messages: claims-section presence vs section source-span alignment vs claim-text alignment. Mixed fail/pass combinations all emit; the filter concatenates issues rather than masking a union.

Independent facts ANDed to emit a candidate: five-axis scope overlap vs correlative/opposite party-kind-content coincidence. Mixed pairs are legal no-candidate outcomes; only both-true constructs LegalOppositionCandidateInput.

Independent BoxError classifiers used on different paths: retryable (429/>=500 or transport) feeds DmsMirrorUnavailable; name-conflict (409 or item_name_in_use) resolves create collisions. Combined-true is not a stored phase and is not exclusive-read.

S.is guards over Box SDK payload shapes at the DmsMirrorBox driver boundary; Match.when arms project file/folder/event-source into BoxSourceInfo. Mirrors upstream SDK contracts, not a domain state machine flattened into bits.

S.is membership of existing LiteralKit subdomains over one HohfeldPositionKind. Advantage overlaps both orbits (claim/privilege vs power/immunity); deontic vs potestative is a partition already modeled as literals, not stored parallel flags.

Independent interval-algebra helpers (half-open start-before-end, overlap, containment) composed into proposal applicability. Overlap and containment can both hold; they are not exclusive dispatch phases.

Independent frame-shape validators: distinct element labels vs presence of an actor slot. A frame can fail one and pass the other; hasDerivationKind is a third nonempty-set check on a different field.
Independent mutation refusals: no-op delta (added/removed empty) vs an addQuad that classifies into the shapes partition. Each has its own ensure* failure; mixed true/false is legal.

GraphTerm match helpers implementing PartitionGraphCoherenceCheck. DefaultGraph vs named canonical partition are tagged-union arms already; both-false is ordinary blank/other named graphs. Not stored parallel flags.
Independent calendar classifiers: leap-year of a year vs validity of a y/m/d triple. Feb 29 on a leap year is both-true; Jan 1 on a common year is valid-without-leap. Not a masked union.
